groups.name: super-controller
groups.description: Core configuration properties for Super-Controller library.

groups.name: super-controller.class-suffix
groups.description: Configure naming conventions for class suffixes used in automatic class discovery.

groups.name: super-controller.path
groups.description: Configure package paths for automatic class discovery and scanning.

groups.name: super-controller.controller-advice
groups.description: Configure the built-in controller advice for global exception handling.

properties.name: super-controller.prefix-url
properties.description: Base URL prefix prepended to all controller endpoints. Example: '/api' results in '/api/users'. Note: Version prefix (e.g., '/v1') is automatically added when using URI versioning strategy.

properties.name: super-controller.base-package
properties.description: Base package path for automatic class discovery and scanning. Used to locate policy, request, and service classes. Leave empty to scan from application root package. Example: 'com.myapp' to scan 'com.myapp.policies', 'com.myapp.requests', etc.

properties.name: super-controller.class-suffix.policy
properties.description: Naming convention suffix for authorization policy classes. Used in automatic policy discovery. Example: 'Policy' matches 'UserPolicy', 'ProductPolicy'. Change to customize naming (e.g., 'AuthPolicy' for 'UserAuthPolicy').

properties.name: super-controller.class-suffix.request
properties.description: Naming convention suffix for request DTO classes. Used in automatic request class discovery. Example: 'Request' matches 'StoreUserRequest', 'UpdateProductRequest'. Change to customize naming (e.g., 'DTO' for 'UserDTO').

properties.name: super-controller.class-suffix.service
properties.description: Naming convention suffix for service classes. Used in automatic service discovery. Example: 'Service' matches 'UserService', 'ProductService'. Change to customize naming (e.g., 'Manager' for 'UserManager').

properties.name: super-controller.path.policies
properties.description: Package path segment for authorization policy classes relative to base-package. Example: 'policies' scans '{base-package}.policies'. Change to match your project structure (e.g., 'security.policies').

properties.name: super-controller.path.requests
properties.description: Package path segment for request DTO classes relative to base-package. Example: 'requests' scans '{base-package}.requests'. Change to match your project structure (e.g., 'dto.requests' or 'api.dto').

properties.name: super-controller.path.services
properties.description: Package path segment for service classes relative to base-package. Example: 'services' scans '{base-package}.services'. Change to match your project structure (e.g., 'domain.services' or 'business').

properties.name: super-controller.controller-advice.enable
properties.description: Enable or disable the built-in global exception handler (@ControllerAdvice). When enabled, provides automatic error responses for common exceptions (validation errors, not found, access denied, etc.). Disable if you want to use your own custom exception handling.
